name: Four Seasons Resort Bora Bora
positioning: All-suite private island resort with overwater bungalow suites and beachfront villa estates on a private motu in Bora Bora
best_for: Families and groups who want a beachfront villa estate

facts.text: The resort is set on a private motu (island) in the string of coral islets surrounding Bora Bora's main island.
The resort overlooks Mount Otemanu and Mount Pahia.
The resort is a 15-minute boat ride from Bora Bora Airport.
Arii Moana offers classics from the Mediterranean region.
Fare Hoa Beach Bar & Restaurant is an open-air restaurant on the sandy shore of the lagoon.
Vaimiti offers an overwater setting for eclectic Asian cuisine.
Te Mahana Spa has seven treatment rooms, including two open-air pavilions.
The resort has two artificial grass tennis courts.
The resort has a Kids for All Seasons program.

highlights.text: The One-Bedroom Otemanu Overwater Bungalow Suite With Plunge Pool lets you step straight into the lagoon from your own private deck.
The Three-Bedroom Premier Beachfront Villa Estate has a secluded beachfront setting spanning over a full acre (0.4 hectares).
Private Dinner on the Motu starts with a boat ride by outrigger canoe to a private white-sand motu, where guests are greeted with champagne, followed by a gourmet dinner at sunset.
In the Overwater Spa Suite, treatment beds sit on glass panels above the lagoon.

considerations.text: Guests are responsible for booking their own flights to Bora Bora, including the interisland flights from Papeete, Tahiti.
Interisland flights may not operate during the late-night or very early hours, so an overnight stay in Tahiti may be required.
Condé Nast Traveler says the majority of guests are well-heeled couples there to celebrate the bigger moments in life.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
